author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದೈನ್ಯತೆಯ ಜೀವನವ ನೋಡಿನೀ ನಗಬೇಡ
ಧನ್ಯವಾಗುವ ಬದುಕ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವೆಯೊ
ಜನ್ಯವಹು ಅವಗುಣವು ಕಾಮಾದಿ ಮದದಿಂದ
ಅನ್ಯರೆಡೆ ಸಹನೆಯಿಡು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Do not laugh when you see a life of humble want;
you may lose the life that could have made you blessed;
vices are born from desire and the other passions’ intoxication —
keep patience toward others, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Do not mock people who live in hardship; the one who laughs may lose the blessings of his own life. Faults grow out of desire and the other passions. Be patient and kind toward others.
